newsitem.title: USA: NFL FOOTBALL-OHIO STATE TACKLE PACE AND TEAMMATE SPRINGS TO ENTER DRAFT.
newsitem.headline: NFL FOOTBALL-OHIO STATE TACKLE PACE AND TEAMMATE SPRINGS TO ENTER DRAFT.

text.p: Star offensive tackle Orlando Pace and defensive back Shawn Springs of Ohio State announced on Monday they will forego their final year of college eligibility and enter the NFL Draft.
Pace, winner of both the Lombardi Award and Outland Trophy for his line play this year and a finalist for the Heisman Trophy, is expected to be among the top two or three picks in the upcoming draft.
Springs, a cornerback, was voted Big Ten Defensive Player of the Year despite not having a single interception because quarterbacks generally did not throw at his side.
Springs has started 37 games over the past three years and has six career interceptions.
Ohio State was 11-1 this season and defeated Arizona State in the Rose Bowl.
